title: Diagnose a panel that touches the wall without connecting
applicability: Use when a part appears flush in the preview but a one-component check separates it from the wall. Static support can allow a separate grounded part to pass geometry checks.
aliases: 墙饰明明贴住却没卡上
steps: Run the connected-component check. Compare the wall and panel occurrences with their connector lists. A common ground plane can support both separately, so a valid static report alone cannot confirm the panel's attachment.

The failing example rests a 3024 against a smooth 3004 wall. The panel's underside socket needs a front-facing stud at its position. Replace the wall fitting with 11211 and use one of its front open studs.
Mate the socket using connect and recheck both component count and collisions. On a wide panel, inspect every intended attachment point so a coincident corner does not hide a shifted or bent layout.
expected: The original is statically valid and reports validation.connectivity with two components. The side-stud mount produces one valid component.
